setup_notes.connection: Initial ADB unauthorized without phone dialog. AOA setup connected; subsequently ADB became authorized. Closing AOA removed ADB forwarding; first ADB startup failed. Re-created forwarding and ADB startup succeeded. All valid trials use ADB 5277; AOA used only in setup.
setup_notes.prior_read_error: A prior setup text filename was absent; recovered exact setup commands from experiment3 timed log.
setup_notes.controller_fix: Exited DHU process caused Broken pipe during setup retry. Controller restarted with poll check before quit/send. No trial was active.
setup_notes.phone_ui: Opened observed Android Auto settings activity and inspected menu via uiautomator; Stop head unit server was present, so server already running. Temporary /data/local/tmp/experiment4-ui.xml must be removed.
setup_notes.guidance_deviation: R100-r1 automatic resume left Naver on the non-guidance phone-position map. No trial sent. Recent-destination recovery initially failed because first tap only revealed auto-hidden controls; revealing controls explicitly, opening search, and selecting Mipo restored guidance. Initial private-location screenshots withheld. Recovered guidance initially still showed the phone-origin route; 12 additional 1Hz stationary 5m fixes settled it to the verified 2.4km test route before starting the trial.
setup_notes.other_diagnostic_warning: Pillow getdata deprecation warning in auxiliary image analysis; changed to get_flattened_data. No experiment input affected.
setup_notes.frame_comparison: Used pre-existing Pillow for auxiliary pixel-difference/blue-pixel candidate detection, then visually inspected boundary frames. No images were edited.
setup_notes.dhu_warnings: USB AOA setup log contains 2 Ping timeout warnings. Valid ADB trials show Audio stream already playing warnings; no location-command errors found.

timing_semantics: Times are host dispatch or file-save times, not phone sensor timestamps. Trial samples labeled t are taken approximately 0.2s after fix t; rendering can lag. Constant runs sampled every 10s, ramp runs every 1s.
limits: DHU screen behavior, not direct inspection of sensor acceptance inside the app.
No actual vehicle, dongle or sensor timestamp field measured.
Remaining distance rounded to 0.1km. Display speed is a separate indicator and cannot alone prove coordinate following.
Phone location permissions unchanged; indoor GPS strength not measured during this experiment.
Gray-icon onset may lag cessation of position following; do not equate accuracy at gray onset with a hard acceptance cutoff.

summary.interpretation: Ramp display-stop values approximately 50-53.5m are compatible with a cutoff near 50m plus processing/render delay; not proof of the exact cutoff or equality of internal thresholds.

cleanup.retained: outputs/ evidence; pre-existing Java and Python unchanged
